_doc: Which prompt shapes map to which SAP-entry skill. Read by harness/bin/skill_router.py: `table` prints the routing table at SessionStart, `match` reads each prompt (UserPromptSubmit) and names the skill(s) to invoke first. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes over the prompt text. A route is listed only if its skill folder exists on this checkout, so harness/desks.json exclusions apply on their own. Edit, commit, push - every box picks it up at its next session.

always_after.when: AFTER ANY A/P draft - attach the bill, `sapb1 add-draft`, verify WddStatus='W'. Oil only: Mart/Bev stop at the draft (C-0074). A bill is not done at the draft.

routes.when: invoices that arrived in a MAILBOX - check the mail, count them, download them to Documents. Reads mail only; never enters anything in SAP
vendor TAX INVOICE / purchase bill for GOODS - a GRPO exists behind it; also 'is this bill already in SAP?'

CONSUMABLES / DIRECT or INDIRECT EXPENSE bill that DID come through a PO + GRPO - ink & make-up cartridges, chemicals, housekeeping, refreshment, stationery, lab, RMC/concrete, hardware; also the CAPEX bills on the same tray (GroupMask 1 vs 5). The printed PO number picks the book, not the buyer GSTIN
vendor bill with NO goods receipt behind it - services, job work, repairs, professional fees, plate charges
a CREDIT NOTE or DEBIT NOTE a vendor issued to JIVO (rate difference, shortage, return)
a payment TO a vendor - advance against a PO/contract, or settlement of open bills; an approved payment-request mail
a BANK STATEMENT whose lines must be entered (receipts, charges, transfers)
a landlord's RENT invoice for any JIVO premises

CASH VOUCHER TYPE 1 - the voucher that HAS an existing GRPO behind it. A JIVO WELLNESS voucher slip + supplier's bill + a SAP Goods Receipt Note printout, or a cash-sheet row whose amount matches an open GRPO on the FACTORY IMPREST card. One A/P draft per voucher, COPIED from that GRPO so the G/L comes from the GRPO's item

CASH VOUCHER TYPE 2 - the voucher whose paper is a REGISTERED VENDOR'S GST TAX INVOICE and there is NO GRPO behind it. A JIVO WELLNESS voucher slip clipped to a printed tax invoice with a GSTIN and CGST/SGST. The A/P goes to the REAL VENDOR on the letterhead, never the imprest card, so the input credit lands on that vendor's GSTIN. Service draft, bod_GSTTaxInvoice; posting date = the gate stamp, document date = the bill, vendor ref = the bill number, remarks = the bare voucher number

CASH VOUCHER TYPE 3 - the MANUAL voucher: NO GRPO and NO BILL, just the JIVO WELLNESS slip (or a cash-sheet row with no paper behind it) - punctures, vehicle repairs, conveyance, porter charges, kitchen, medical, small hardware. Service draft on the holder's FACTORY IMPREST card, expense head picked from the wording, TaxCode Exampt, vendor ref = the bunch reference off the cash sheet, Dim1 = the vehicle the slip brackets
patterns: voucher.*(no bill|without bill|no grpo and no bill)

routes.when: a CASH SHEET of numbered cash vouchers, or a DocScanner pack of JIVO WELLNESS voucher slips with their bills and GRPO prints. ONE A/P draft PER VOUCHER, copied from that voucher's GRPO so the G/L comes from the GRPO's item. Posting date = the slip; document date = the bill; Dim2 = the slip's month; Dim3 from the slip's Common mark; NumAtCard bunch = that table's own Total
an EMPLOYEE expense claim / reimbursement voucher (conveyance, fuel, toll, travel) - IMPREST vendor accounts
a LABOUR contractor's loading / unloading bill (Oil or Beverages)
a tanker of LOOSE / BULK oil - the supplier's tax invoice (qty in KG, gate-in stamp, ball-pen shortage) plus the JIVO PO it came against. Daman calls it 'oil GRPO'. Not the transporter's freight bill
TRANSPORTER freight bill / bilty / LR billed to JIVO OIL - raise the freight GRPOs. The BILL-TO decides the book: Oil sale invoices 626xxxxxx
the same freight bill but billed to JIVO MART (sale invoices 707xxxxxx)
the same freight bill but billed to JIVO BEVERAGES (wellness water)
asked to submit / send to Bhawani / send for approval / 'add and new', or why a draft is not in the Approval Status Report
one PDF of everything entered today / on a date (write log + SAP read-back)
asked WHICH DRAFTS CAN BE POSTED now / a morning check of the draft pile / why a draft is still waiting. Splits ready-to-post from stuck-in-JSAP. Reads only

transporter BILTY / G.R. / LR sheets whose A/R sale invoices must be COMPLETED - attach the scan, bilty date on header AND every line, Received Qty = Quantity, Received Date. Matches on the INVOICE NUMBER off the bilty's B/L No. Attach FIRST (guard 130001002); a wrong bilty number does not matter

CANCEL / reverse / 'delete' a POSTED document (invoice, GRPO, credit note, delivery, order) - right-click -> Cancel. Finds it in all three books by DocNum (C-0073), dry-runs, gets the operator's word, reports original + reversal. Never payments or journal entries
